explanation: The response successfully included both valid species of the genus Tyrannosaurus as of May 2024: Tyrannosaurus rex and Tyrannosaurus mcraeensis. However, it also included proposed, synonymised, or dubious species (Tyrannosaurus imperator, Tyrannosaurus regina, Tyrannosaurus bataar, Tyrannosaurus lanpingensis, Tyrannosaurus turpanensis, Tyrannosaurus luanchuanensis, Tyrannosaurus zhuchengensis) which are excessive.
